receipts.history_boundary: Append-only November 21 review. All fourteen earlier current-ledger receipts, both September Starlink receipts, the Nextlink September decision and original baseline files remain exact. Shared program inspections are identified, not represented as independent fetches. Two provider identities remain separate; no cycle identity is added.
receipts.validation_boundary_at_recording: Source assignments are locally testable. Full production/output acceptance remains unperformed while the output-delete restriction blocks the build; no publication or cycle closure is claimed.

receipts.bounded_finding: Retain the Nextlink adoption signal In Review. State and provider releases support the May tower activation and availability for 104 Bossier locations, not a measured subscriber count for that cohort. The newer supplemental-round announcement is a separate eligibility process.
receipts.evidence_boundary: Actual November 21 inspection catches up October 9, preserving the September 9 primary schedule and September 10 decision. No qualifying fixed-cohort subscription or take-rate return was retrieved in this bounded review; that does not establish nonexistence or zero customers. Company-wide subscriber totals and deployment forecasts cannot be allocated to 104 eligible locations. Two listed article bodies remained inaccessible; their older observations were not reused as fresh evidence. No address, account, challenge or customer-data query was submitted.
receipts.next_action: On December 21, seek a dated observed subscription or take-rate return for the 104-location Bossier service cohort, or another explicitly fixed Louisiana BEAD cohort, with the same eligible-location denominator and disclosed method. Keep tower geography, served-area geography, statewide awards and provider-wide subscribers distinct. Save a bounded decision if unavailable. This is an editorial checkpoint, not a publication forecast; reopen earlier only for an exact newly discovered qualifying artifact.
